question: Photo: Cornea with macrostriae post refractive surgery, how many weeks post op?
explanation: When present, macrostriae almost always become apparent in the early postoperative period. It is important to recognize and address this complication early, as the success of interventions decreases greatly over time, and this problem can cause visually significant irregular astigmatism. The surgeon must examine the surgical eye(s) carefully to check for the presence of gross fullthickness folds (intraoperatively) or flap slippage (postoperatively).- AAO. Note, though no specific time mentioned, will go with A.
